# Godot 引擎复刻传奇项目知识图谱

## 总体概览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start["复刻戈多引擎传奇项目"]
    Tools["使用Godot 4.7 + GDScript"]
    MapDisplay["地图显示已达可接受水平"]
    CharacterControl["人物移动跟手"]
    WeatherSystem["天气系统（昼夜、雨、雪）"]
    Issues["仍有问题（灯光、传送点、闪烁）"]
    Optimization["后续优化空间"]
    Outcome["记录学习过程"]
    Start --> Tools
    Start --> MapDisplay
    Start --> CharacterControl
    Start --> WeatherSystem
    MapDisplay --> Issues
    WeatherSystem --> Issues
    Issues --> Optimization
    Optimization --> Outcome
```

## 天气系统细节
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    WeatherSystem["天气系统"]
    DayNightCycle["昼夜24h循环"]
    Rain["雨"]
    Snow["雪"]
    Audio["配套音效"]
    Visibility["夜间可见范围"]
    Settings["自定义设置"]
    Effects["特效（云、雾）"]
    WeatherSystem --> DayNightCycle
    WeatherSystem --> Rain
    WeatherSystem --> Snow
    Rain --> Audio
    Snow --> Audio
    DayNightCycle --> Visibility
    Settings --> Effects
    Effects --> Visibility
```

## 开发工作流与数据转换
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    OriginalLegend["韩版传奇二源码 (C#)"]
    DataConversion["数据转换过程"]
    GodotEngine["Godot (GDScript)"]
    MapEdit["在Godot编辑器直接修改"]
    IssueFix["修复灯光格数错误"]
    TestRun["运行并测试传送点"]
    Optimization["持续优化"]
    Documentation["记录视频"]
    OriginalLegend --> DataConversion
    DataConversion --> GodotEngine
    GodotEngine --> MapEdit
    MapEdit --> IssueFix
    IssueFix --> TestRun
    TestRun --> Optimization
    Optimization --> Documentation
```

## 选择 Godot 引擎的理由
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Decision["综合考虑"]
    EngineChoice["选择Godot引擎"]
    OpenSource["开源"]
    Community["社区资料丰富"]
    Language["GDScript (类C++)"]
    MultiDim["支持2D+3D"]
    LearningCurve["上手快"]
    AIHelper["AI辅助编码"]
    Decision --> EngineChoice
    EngineChoice --> OpenSource
    EngineChoice --> Community
    EngineChoice --> Language
    EngineChoice --> MultiDim
    EngineChoice --> LearningCurve
    EngineChoice --> AIHelper
```
